Name: Meshullam, Father of Hilkiah
Summary: Father of Hilkiah in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Zadok son of Meraioth.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:11: Father of Hilkiah in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Zadok son of Meraioth.
LifeLesson: The mention of Meshullam in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
